name: Strata — native JSON server
description: Configure prepared Strata models using named model-file, expert-cache, speculation, context, GPU and runtime controls. Discovery adds build-specific options and compatibility guidance. GPU placement remains engine-native and unverified.

fields.label: Fill missing primary model path from catalog
fields.description: Create mode uses the catalog path for this flag only when that path is not already configured below. Native GGUF, pack and PLE paths can be used together. Import mode preserves its configured paths.
fields.source: serve/server.py model_path: --native / --pack

fields.label: Model architecture / family
fields.description: Optional Strata architecture name for server/model behavior. Leave unset to retain its native default. This does not establish model compatibility.
fields.source: serve/server.py cfg.arch and default_model_name

fields.label: Tokenizer directory
fields.description: Prepared tokenizer directory containing vocab.json, merges.txt and token_type.json.

fields.label: Prepared pack directory
fields.description: Optional prepared pack directory. Can accompany native GGUF and supplemental PLE files.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Native GGUF file
fields.description: Native model file, including the first shard when the configuration uses a separate PLE file.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Supplemental PLE GGUF file
fields.description: Supplemental GGUF path required by some Strata model layouts. Kept alongside the native GGUF and pack.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Expert profile file
fields.description: Expert profile supplied to the engine. Leave unset to retain its native setting.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Expert cache size
fields.description: Engine-native cache value, such as auto or a slot count. No value is forced by VisLlama.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Prefill chunk setting
fields.description: Engine-native value, such as auto, a token count, or auto:N when supported.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Remote expert optimization
fields.description: Passes --remote-expert-opt to the native engine. Meaning and support depend on the installed build; no performance benefit is assumed.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Speculation depth
fields.description: Number passed to the native speculative decoding option. Leave unset to retain the engine setting.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Speculation minimum probability
fields.description: Minimum probability passed to native speculation.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: MTP runtime directory
fields.description: Prepared MTP runtime directory for the selected model. VisLlama does not download or generate it.
fields.source: User-supplied Strata configuration and reviewed upstream interface; engine validates runtime support.

fields.label: Context size (tokens)
fields.description: Full model context limit, not the resident KV window.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: KV cache format
fields.description: Engine-native format, e.g. int8, q4_0 or k8v4 when supported. Leave blank for the build default.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Resident KV window (tokens)
fields.description: Size of the KV window kept resident. This is not the full context size.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: RoPE scaling
fields.description: Use a scaling mode supported by this model/build.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: RoPE scale factor
fields.description: Explicit scaling factor; the model and engine must support the selected context.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: GPU selection (Strata device numbers)
fields.description: One GPU or comma-separated GPUs, e.g. 0,2. Passed to Strata as entered; VisLlama does not verify placement or reinterpret these as llama.cpp CUDA ordinals.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: GPU order
fields.description: Use engine default for Strata ordering, or as_given to retain the entered order.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: Layer / pipeline split points
fields.description: auto, or the first layer on each later GPU, e.g. 18 or 16,32. These are boundaries, not layer counts. Requires several selected GPUs. Strata verifies compatibility.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: Use one GPU when the model fits
fields.description: Strata may use the first selected GPU alone with an automatic split when it fits.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: Strata GPU selection marker (gpus_asked)
fields.description: Strata configuration metadata from setup. This is not evidence of verified GPU placement in VisLlama.

fields.label: Concurrent request slots
fields.description: Requests decoded together; this is request batching, separate from GPU parallelism. Choosing this replaces imported --batch/--slots arguments in the generated configuration.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Native engine reserve for other programs. Does not enable VisLlama Calculated planning.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Later GPUs VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Separate native reserve for later layer-split GPUs.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Keep experts in resident RAM
fields.description: Native resident expert-memory mode. Enabling it replaces an imported --mmap-experts flag in generated arguments.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Resident expert RAM budget (GiB)
fields.description: Native RAM budget for resident experts. This does not download or repack a model.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Elastic VRAM expert cache
fields.description: Allow Strata native elastic-cache behavior when supported by the model and engine.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: Elastic VRAM segment (MiB)
fields.description: Native segment size, applied when elastic VRAM is enabled.
fields.source: Reviewed serve/server.py configuration mapping

fields.label: Strata inference executable
fields.description: Runs the model: strata.exe on Windows, or the native Strata binary on Linux. Blank uses the inference executable registered for this build.

fields.label: Working directory
fields.description: Blank uses the registered installation directory in Create mode.

fields.label: Native library folders
fields.description: Folders used to find DLLs/shared libraries. Imported folders are kept. Add, browse or detect folders without editing JSON.

fields.label: CUDA version in Strata configuration
fields.description: Preserves the CUDA version recorded in Strata JSON, for example 12. This does not install CUDA or verify executable/library compatibility.

fields.label: Default reasoning effort
fields.source: serve/server.py; model/build-dependent

fields.label: Fit output tokens to context
fields.source: serve/server.py

fields.label: Full native argument array (advanced)
fields.description: Preserved native argument tokens. Named controls below display matching values; editing one replaces only its corresponding option. Unknown tokens stay unchanged.

evidence: Source review: Niko1221/Strata serve/server.py blob 2e805773dc56788bfe2f899bc7a78f20bd6db553. No hardware acceptance. Compatible versions share this contract; re-scan each installed build. Configuration creation uses server source keys exe/args/cwd/tokenizer and --native/--pack model selectors. Native option controls require installed-build discovery; no upstream native help could be retrieved in this session. Per-model option sources: docs/MULTI_GPU.md blob 30e316d527d47b5cf2b24b1fcde9c63056a73937; docs/DETAILS.md blob 5c5724f121db8778b038c58e36d4f59787384f0e; docs/INSTALL.md blob 1a7a430951281538154a9d13f1cacb060a2d3b6b. Native controls require installed-build flag evidence. 1.5.10 maps the complete user-supplied strata-iq3_xxs.json (combined --pack/--native/--ple-gguf, expert-profile/cache, prefill, spec/spec-min-p/mtp, remote-expert-opt, cuda and gpus_asked). Remote-expert-opt semantics are intentionally not inferred. Reviewed base fields have advisory discovery; discovered additions retain strict build evidence. Existing independent model selectors are retained.

executable.label: Python interpreter
executable.description: Runs Strata’s server.py. Select the python.exe in your prepared Strata environment (.venv/Scripts on Windows, .venv/bin/python on Linux).

runtime_executable.label: Strata inference executable
runtime_executable.description: Runs the model. Select strata.exe on Windows, or the native Strata binary on Linux. Also used for option discovery; separate from the Python interpreter.
